preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM clinlims.program WHERE code = 'HIV_VL'

changeSet.comment: Seeds the HIV viral load programme and its order-entry questionnaire so the test-triggered programme works on every install. The questionnaire id is fixed so the programme can reference it.

INSERT INTO clinlims.program (id, code, name, lastupdated, questionnaire_fhir_uuid, domain, is_active) SELECT COALESCE(MAX(id), 0) + 1, 'HIV_VL', 'HIV Viral Load', now(), '6f1d9c3e-8a47-4b52-9e0a-3c5b7d2a1f84'::uuid, 'CLINICAL', 'Y' FROM clinlims.program;
DO $$ BEGIN PERFORM setval('clinlims.program_seq', GREATEST((SELECT MAX(id) FROM clinlims.program)::bigint, (SELECT last_value FROM clinlims.program_seq))); END $$;
